_readme: The remote stop button. Every TrustIQ app reads this file at launch.
It lives here, on a static host, rather than in the database, for two
reasons. The schema tests hold an absolute line that no function in public
is callable with the key that ships inside the app, and a status readable
before sign-in would have needed a hole in it. And a stop button housed in
the system it is meant to stop is not a stop button: the day Supabase has
an incident is exactly when you want to say so, and exactly when the
mode: 'open' or 'maintenance'. Anything else means open. The app fails
open on every path: a bad connection, a 404, malformed JSON, a slow
server. A switch that bricks the app when the network is poor is worse
than no switch, and TrustIQ has testers on 3G.
minimumBuild: the oldest build allowed to run. Match it to the '+N' in
apps/mobile/pubspec.yaml, which is also the Play versionCode. A build that
does not know its own number is never held back.
notice: shown to the person, in their language. Say what is happening and
when it ends. Leave both empty for the app's own wording.
Changing this needs a commit and a Pages deploy, two or three minutes.
That is the price of it being somewhere that survives everything else.
